value.name: review remaining estate items
value.description: The group works through the remaining non-speech estate items, including property division, bank accounts, and the final tax return.
evidence: They worked through items six, seven, and eight.
These were the items that did not require speeches: the disposition of the personal property
the resolution of the bank accounts
the filing of the final tax return

value.name: confirm property division agreement
value.description: Asha notices that Lucia and Daniel have already divided the personal property and marked some items for Rosa with Daniel's agreement.
evidence: Lucia and Daniel had divided over the weekend with a list that ran to two and a half pages
that contained, Asha noticed, a number of entries marked to Rosa, in Lucia's handwriting, against which Daniel had, at some point, written agreed

value.name: schedule account closure and tax filing
value.description: The siblings agree to close the small bank accounts by month's end and have Asha prepare the final tax return for signing in early February.
evidence: the resolution of the bank accounts, which were small and which would be closed by the end of the month
the filing of the final tax return, which Asha would prepare and which the siblings would sign in her office in early February
value.time_hint: by the end of the month; early February

value.name: Rosa serves coffee repeatedly
value.description: Rosa pours coffee twice and then makes another pot when the first is empty.
evidence: Rosa poured coffee twice and then, when the pot was empty, made another pot

value.name: Rosa stops Daniel from helping
value.description: When Daniel tries to get up to help, Rosa tells him to stay seated and let her handle the coffee.
evidence: when Daniel started to stand up to help her she waved him back into his chair
"Sit. You are signing things. I am making coffee. We are each doing what we are good at."

value.name: sign estate documents
value.description: By 12:30, everyone has signed the documents and Asha gathers them away.
evidence: By twelve-thirty the documents were signed.
Asha gathered the papers into the folders and the folders into her bag

value.name: Lucia invites Asha to lunch
value.description: After the paperwork is finished, Lucia asks Asha to stay for lunch.

value.name: Asha declines due to afternoon appointment
value.description: Asha says she has a two o'clock appointment and cannot stay long.

value.name: Rosa insists Asha eat soup
value.description: Rosa urges Asha to sit down and eat soup, saying the estate is closed and Asha is no longer billing them.
evidence: "Then stay for thirty minutes. Rosa made soup yesterday. There is enough for four. There has been enough for four every day this week, which I think she has been doing on purpose."
"I have been doing it on purpose," Rosa said. "Sit down, Asha. The estate is closed. You are no longer billing us. You can have soup."

value.name: Asha accepts the invitation
value.description: Asha sits down, yielding to Rosa's invitation to stay for soup.
